text.p: ShoLodge Inc said Friday it has completed a transaction to repurchase, for $2.05 million, the warrant held by a unit of Shoney's Inc in order to acquire five percent of the company's stock.

The warrants entitled Shoney's Investments Inc to acquire about 560,000 shares of the company's stock. Of that total, about 438,000 shares, with an average exercise price of $9.49 per share, were exercisable at prices below the current trading quote for ShoLodge's shares, it said.

Under the same agreement, ShoLodge paid Shoney's Investments $5.25 million to cancel the future obligations to pay a portion of the franchise fees generated by the Shoney's Inn chain to Shoney's Investments.
The fees paid to Shoney's currently amount to $1.1 million a year, the company said.
